label: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE EXPECTATIONS. Independent brute-force oracle (this script: parse the written bytes by column/whitespace, math.dist over all heavy-atom pairs, simulated preparation). No gemmi, no mw code. Not experimental.

how.distances: float64 math.dist over every heavy-atom pair (element not H/D) of the prepared residue and the other residue; minimum
how.prepare: H/D removed; altloc highest_occupancy = highest mean occupancy, tie by letter; first = first letter met; waters kept (prepare_structure config defaults)
how.polymer: residue whose every record is ATOM (spec 2: category polymer)
how.metal: HETATM residue named in Zn Mg Ca Mn Fe Cu Co Ni Na K (CD is not; HOH is water)
how.ligand_candidates: HETATM, not water, not in the metal list (spec 2 ligand selector)
how.disulfide: SG of CYS/CYX polymer residues, SG-SG <= 2.5 A; partner = nearest, tie -> first in file order
how.standard: 20 standard names + 10 mapped names (HID HIE HIP HSD HSE HSP CYX ASH GLH LYN)

placement_notes.A11: LYS NZ altloc A 2.5 A (occ 0.30) / B 3.5 A (occ 0.70) from ZN
placement_notes.B1: NA at 2.2 A (other chain near a metal)
placement_notes.A13: CD at 2.0 A (CD is not in the metal list)

placement_notes.A8: SG-SG 2.05 A with CYS A5 (variant name CYX)

placement_notes.B20: SG-SG exactly 2.5 A with CYS A20

placement_notes.B22: SG-SG 2.4 A tie with CYS A22 and CYS B23
